test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following nuclear power plants has been INCORRECTLY matched with the state within which it is located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalpakkam - Karnataka**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kakrapar** is located in Gujarat.
 
• **Kalpakkam** is located in Tamil Nadu, not Karnataka.
 
• **Kudankulam** is located in Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Kaiga** is located in Karnataka.
 
• Therefore, the incorrect match is **Kalpakkam - Karnataka**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kakrapar Atomic Power Station (KAPS)** is situated in the state of Gujarat.
 
• **Madras Atomic Power Station (MAPS)**, also known as Kalpakkam, is situated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant (KKNPP)** is located in the Tirunelveli district of Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Kaiga Generating Station (KGS)** is situated near the river Kali in Karnataka.
